30 Story templates. Stories are for people who already know you, and they're where warm people decide to buy. Each template is 4 frames: question or problem → proof or demo → answer or result → the ask. Use one sticker per frame, keep the link sticker inside the safe zone, and use urgency only when it's true. Save your best ones to Highlights.
1Quote nudgeSell
  1. Poll: "Anything in your house that's 'fine for now'?" (Yes / Definitely yes)
  2. An 8-second clip: a small problem that became a big one
  3. One line on what early fixes usually cost
  4. Link sticker: "Free quote, same-day reply"

Did it do its job? Look at Poll votes, link taps, quote requests.

2Real availabilitySell
  1. A favorite photo from a recent job or session
  2. A behind-the-scenes clip + question sticker: "What do you want to know before booking?"
  3. Real open dates (only if true)
  4. Link sticker: "Pick your date"

Did it do its job? Look at Link taps, bookings.

3RestockSell
  1. Question sticker: "Which color should come back?"
  2. Behind the scenes: packing the restock
  3. When it drops and any bundle price (only if true)
  4. Link sticker to the listing

Did it do its job? Look at Replies, listing taps, orders.

4DemoSell
  1. "[Deadline] and no [thing] yet?"
  2. A 10-second screen recording or demo
  3. A real review screenshot (with permission)
  4. Link sticker: price + "instant download"

Did it do its job? Look at Link taps, sales.

5Objection answered on cameraTrust + Sell
  1. Question box: "What stops you from [buying/booking]?"
  2. Answer the top reply on camera
  3. A real, approved result (or labeled illustrative)
  4. Link sticker: "Book a 20-minute call"

Did it do its job? Look at Replies, DMs, bookings.

6This or thatTrust
  1. Poll: two options of your product
  2. Poll: two more options
  3. Show the winners
  4. Link sticker to the winning item

Did it do its job? Look at Poll votes, link taps.

7Quiz: guess the priceTrust
  1. Quiz sticker: "What does [product/service] cost?" (3 options)
  2. Reveal the real price
  3. What's included for that price
  4. Link sticker

Did it do its job? Look at Quiz answers, link taps.

8FAQ in 4 framesTrust
  1. "You asked:" + the #1 question
  2. Answer
  3. Question 2 + answer
  4. Link sticker: "Everything else is here"

Did it do its job? Look at Replies, link taps.

9Behind the scenesTrust
  1. Where you are right now (one line)
  2. The work in progress
  3. The finished result
  4. Question box: "What should I show next?"

Did it do its job? Look at Replies, profile visits.

10Before / afterTrust + Sell
  1. The "before" + slider sticker: "How bad is this?"
  2. The process in 5 seconds
  3. The "after"
  4. Link sticker to your next step

Did it do its job? Look at Slider responses, link taps.

11Launch countdownSell
  1. A teaser: part of the new thing
  2. Countdown sticker to the real launch time
  3. One detail people will care about
  4. Link sticker (on launch day)

Did it do its job? Look at Reminder taps, launch-day link taps.

12Ask me anythingTrust
  1. Question box: "Ask me anything about [your work]"
  2. Answer 1 (on camera or text)
  3. Answer 2
  4. Link sticker to your next step

Did it do its job? Look at Questions received, DMs.

13Which should I make next?Reach
  1. Poll: two product or content ideas
  2. Show a sketch or draft of each
  3. Results + "Making it this week"
  4. Link sticker to what's available now

Did it do its job? Look at Poll votes, replies.

14Packing ordersTrust
  1. "Packing today's orders"
  2. A close-up of one order (no names or addresses)
  3. Emoji slider: "How cute is this packaging?"
  4. Link sticker: "Order by [day] to get it by [day]" (only if true)

Did it do its job? Look at Slider responses, link taps.

15How to order (walkthrough)Sell
  1. "Here's how to order in 30 seconds"
  2. A screen recording of your checkout or booking page
  3. What happens after (shipping, confirmation, next steps)
  4. Link sticker

Did it do its job? Look at Link taps, checkout or booking starts.

16Myth busterTrust
  1. Poll: "True or false: [myth]?"

  3. Why it matters
  4. Link sticker to your next step

Did it do its job? Look at Poll votes, sends.

17Keyword replySell
  1. The problem your offer solves
  2. Proof or a demo
  3. "Reply [WORD] and I'll send you the link"
  4. A reminder frame with the word in large text

Did it do its job? Look at Keyword replies (answer every one), sales.

Did it do its job? Look at Link taps, replies.

Did it do its job? Look at Link taps, orders.

  4. Link sticker: "More like this" or your next step

Did it do its job? Look at Sends, replies.

Did it do its job? Look at Replies, link taps.

23Slider check-inReach
  1. Emoji slider: "How ready are you for [season/event]?"

Did it do its job? Look at Slider responses, link taps.

Did it do its job? Look at Replies.

Did it do its job? Look at Poll votes, link taps.

28Day in the lifeTrust
  1. Morning start
  2. The main work

Did it do its job? Look at Replies, profile visits.

29Review of the weekTrust + Sell
  1. A real review (with permission, no private details)

Did it do its job? Look at Link taps.

30Direct askSell
  1. Who this is for, in one line
  2. What they get
  3. What it costs and what happens next
  4. Link sticker with a specific action ("Pick your date," "Get the kit")

Did it do its job? Look at Link taps, orders or bookings.
